description:
In this role you will provide technical expertise in the design, development, testing and debugging of new and/or complex enhancements to test and automation software supporting highly skilled, low-level Pearl and Python developers.
 • Leverages knowledge of ASP/.Net, Pearl, Python and Virtualization technologies in a heterogeneous environment while working within an Agile development team to create product backlogs, iterate through sprint planning and release cycles, and deliver critical solutions supporting product teams
 • Creates and modifies test scripts to certify system changes
 • Executes test scripts to ensure quality software is producedfor release
 • Reviews requirements, specifications, and documentation to gain a thorough understanding of the software products and processes to be engineered and automated
 • Assists with configuration management tasks on projects as required and helps author traceability matrices and test reports
 • Develops and maintains test control databases that ensurestest data integrity for distribution to development staff for comprehensive unit testing
 • Resolves developer requirements fortest automation software and collaborates with product teams to apply innovative approaches to software modifications and/or enhancement
 • Researches, analyzes, and provides strategy for new and emerging test automation tools and techniques, to ensure the best automation solutions are availa

 Requirements (yes, required means required) 
 Perform development in support of infrastructure automation initiatives
 Prepare documentation on the configuration and use of automation tools
 Languages: Pearl, Python, visual basic
 Work with Vmware tools, IBM, Solarwinds, others
 
 This is an opportunity we are looking to hire asap, please apply soon!
